title: This phone's Android build has not been tested with Omarchy Mobile yet
body: This phone's bootloader and baseband match Google's build TEST.260301.001. That build has not been tested with Omarchy Mobile yet, and the installer uses a build only after a release was tested with it.
Nothing you can install today changes that. No newer build in the release's list was tested either, so an Android update does not help.

What you can do is wait: once build TEST.260301.001 has been tested, a later release of Omarchy Mobile lists it as tested, and the installer then goes on with this phone as it is. To ask about it, or to see whether someone already has, use the project's issue tracker: https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
